subtitle: Out Cebu · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly Cebu to Quanzhou on Xiamen Airlines, then on to Beijing for Tiananmen Square, the Great Wall and the Forbidden City. A 2nd-class bullet train takes you to Shanghai for the Bund and Chenghuangmiao Temple. Seven nights in 4-star hotels. Shop visits are part of this tour.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 23–30 2027 to Mar 16–23 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: Beijing's vast central square, flanked by the Great Hall of the People and the gate to the Forbidden City.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Pedestrian Street: A busy pedestrian shopping street in central Beijing with stores and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-preserved section of the Great Wall in a mountain pass north of Beijing.
placeDesc.Water Cube: The Beijing 2008 Olympic swimming arena with a bubble-like facade; outside view only.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's Olympic stadium with its steel lattice design; outside view only.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of China's Ming and Qing emperors, visited with entrance ticket.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional pedestrian street south of Tiananmen Square, with shops and snacks.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's TV tower with its distinctive spheres, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Chenghuangmiao Temple: A traditional temple area in old Shanghai surrounded by a bazaar of shops and snacks.
